description: sflow_2d_amr_bar_sub with the two levels on the flat crest of the bar only (0.1 m of water, 0.4 m on level 0): level 0 limits the step, so the levels do not take 2 and 4 steps per level-0 step but the steps their own CFL number needs (sflow_amr::sub_choose: 1 and 2). B 95 -1 is set by G 7 1.
covers: sflow_amr::sub_choose: steps per level other than two (msub), time weights of the fills, regrid count in steps of the finest level
